output_text: "A rig carrying 280 tonnes of diesel oil ran aground off Lewis during a storm on Monday while being transported to Malta. The Maritime and Coastguard Agency has warned sightseers to stay away from the scene and has put a 300m temporary exclusion zone around Dalmore beach. A salvage team is inspecting the rig, which broke free from its tug during towing and severe weather prevented the line being reconnected. The rig is expected to be refloated and assessed in favorable weather conditions."
